name: Starfruit (Carambola)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to low FODMAP content and minimal fermentable sugars.
preparationTips: Wash thoroughly and slice crosswise to create star shapes
Remove any brown edges or spots before eating
Can be eaten with skin on - no peeling required
Best when fully ripe and yellow with slight browning on ridges
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C (boost immune system)
Good source of fiber for digestive health
